files_changed.summary: Revoke public-schema EXECUTE from PUBLIC and anon, grant authenticated, set the default (g1).
A permissive co-member SELECT policy on profiles (g2).
Added tb_test.anon() and the g17/g18 checks (g3).

decisions: EXECUTE is revoked from PUBLIC (Supabase's default) as well as anon, then granted to authenticated; revoking only from anon would leave the PUBLIC grant in force.
Default privileges are set for future public-schema functions, so a later migration cannot silently reopen the front door.
The profiles policy joins team_members on a shared team (both rows exist and are visible to a member under the roster policy), so it grants co-membership only — never a global read.
The changes are additive: no schema/column/function-body change, so 02 §8.1 stays the source of truth.
The checks follow the existing tb_test harness and run under the live RLS suite (npm test in database-thinkboard-lite); this environment has no stack, so that run is deferred.
commands_run: npm run verify (frontend; unaffected — confirms the repo gate stays green)
